subject: Evidence pack request — access traces, export formats, and retention for Orion Financials
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@orionfin.com>, Michael Torres <m.torres@orionfin.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + next steps: access traces & evidence for Orion

Hi Sarah / Michael — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we stay aligned on the audit artifacts you asked for: 

What we discussed (brief):
- You need a reproducible export showing "who accessed what and when" for a 90-day window across the Redwood API that Orion will use (production tokens).
- Preferred formats: NDJSON (preferred), Parquet for analytics, or CSV if required by procurement.
- Required fields: user email/role, request_id, timestamp (UTC), endpoint/model, action (generate/embedding/rerank), input metadata (masked), tokens_in/tokens_out, response_size, and tenant_id.
- Residency: data from Orion production is in us-east-1; evidence needs to show region and KMS key used.
- Retention and certs: you want the retention policy and a short note on SOC 2 evidence we can map to the export.

Requested next steps (what we will deliver):
1) Internal: Aditya will produce a sample NDJSON export (redacted) with a schema mapping and a one-pager describing how fields correlate to audit controls.
2) Dylan/CS: We’ll provide a timeline for a full 90-day export and delivery method (S3 link / secure Share).
3) Lauren/AE: We’ll coordinate contractual language for retention and KMS key confirmation to match your DPA.

Proposed timeline: sample export + schema by EOD Mon (9/13), full export and formal evidence pack by Fri (9/17) if there are no additional fields requested.

If that matches your expectations, reply with any missing fields or if you need a different export format.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this piece so procurement can proceed.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: orion_evidence_request_template.xlsx (template for mapping required fields to export columns)
From: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@orionfin.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Torres <m.torres@orionfin.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps: access traces & evidence for Orion

Thanks Dylan — that lines up with our needs. A couple clarifications from our security and procurement teams: 

1) We need an explicit field showing which KMS key encrypted the request payload/log entry (key ARN or alias).
2) Include a boolean field showing whether the request contained PII (we understand Redwood redacts content, but a flag for "pii_detected" helps our mapping).
3) For NDJSON, please include one sample row with a redacted input (replace text with <REDACTED>) but keep tokens_in/tokens_out accurate.

Export delivery: S3 presigned URL is preferred; encrypted with our customer-managed key if possible (we can provide the key ARN).

Timeline: sample by EOD Monday works. Also confirm if the logs include both successful and failed requests (we want both).

Thanks,
Sarah Chen
Security Ops Manager
Orion Financials

On Thu, Sep 10, 2026 at 3:12 PM Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai> wrote:

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps: access traces & evidence for Orion

Hi all — looping in engineering/security specifics. Quick notes on the export we can produce and constraints: 

Sample we will deliver (attached as sample_access_export.ndjson):
- Fields: timestamp_utc, request_id, user_email, user_role, tenant_id, endpoint, model, action, tokens_in, tokens_out, response_size_bytes, region, kms_key_alias, pii_detected (true/false), status_code, error_message (nullable).
- We will include both successful and failed requests for the window you specify.
- Inputs will be redacted in "input_redacted"; for PII detection we populate the boolean and provide a detection score in "pii_score" (0-1).

Security notes / limitations:
- We cannot export raw unmasked prompt text unless Orion has a Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) integration enabled for the specific project and signs a limited-scope NDA.
- KMS alias will be included when the project is configured to use customer KMS; otherwise we will include the Redwood-managed key alias and confirm residency.

Estimated delivery: sample NDJSON and schema mapping by EOD Mon 9/13 (I will attach). Full 90-day export: aiming for Fri 9/17 but we may need an extra day if you request raw unredacted text under BYOK.

Aditya Rao
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@orionfin.com>

Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps: access traces & evidence for Orion

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clarifications. Deliverables updated: 
- Sample NDJSON (attached) with one redacted example row and full schema mapping.
- We will include kms_key_alias field; if you provide your key ARN we will confirm BYOK eligibility and timeline.
- Both success and failure rows included by default.

Delivery method: secure S3 presigned URL (AES-256 encrypted), and we will share via the Drive link + HubSpot entry. If you prefer customer-managed key, please send the ARN and we’ll route to our infra team.

Next steps for contracting/procurement: Lauren, can you pick up the DPA/KMS language and propose the minimal wording that confirms retention and BYOK?

Sarah / Michael — will ping again when the sample is uploaded.

Thanks,
Dylan

Attachment: sample_access_export.ndjson
From: Michael Torres <m.torres@orionfin.com>

Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence pack request — access traces, export formats, and retention for Orion Financials

Thanks team — we downloaded and reviewed the sample. Quick confirmation items before we close the loop: 
- The NDJSON schema looks good. We see pii_detected and pii_score — could you also add a "pii_category" field (PERSON_NAME / ID / EMAIL / FIN_ACCOUNT) for easier mapping?
- For retention, confirm that Redwood retains operational access logs for 365 days by default and that the 90-day export is a snapshot we can keep in our archive. Please state that in writing for procurement.
- Delivery: S3 presigned URL worked fine. We will follow up on BYOK if we decide to request unredacted content.

If you can add the pii_category to the full export and an explicit retention statement by EOD today, procurement can sign off and we can move to PO generation next week.

Best,
Michael Torres
Head of Procurement | Orion Financials
